nodes.name: application.yml
nodes.summary: Main Spring Boot configuration for the user service covering server port, Spring Cloud, bloom-filter, MyBatis-Plus, Feign, Actuator endpoints, jasypt encryption, captcha verification toggle, and springdoc/knife4j API docs.

nodes.name: log4j2.xml
nodes.summary: Log4j2 configuration for user-service with console and rolling-file appenders (100MB size / 30-file rollover) and a traceId-aware pattern layout; commented-out Logstash socket appender for ELK shipping.

nodes.name: shardingsphere-user-docker.yaml
nodes.summary: ShardingSphere-JDBC configuration (docker profile) defining user_db data sources, user table sharding rules, and column encryption rules for sensitive user data.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses ShardingSphere custom YAML tags (!SHARDING and !ENCRYPT) parsed via a SnakeYAML extension, so plain YAML parsers report unresolved tags.
